Petit
 Through: Mr. Priank Adhyaru, Advocate.

versus
 State Of Nct & Anr. .....

Respo
 Through: Mr. Satinder Singh Bawa, App for
the State with Si Ashutosh Mis
P.S.: Bhajanpura.
Coram:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI  ORDER % 20.04.2023 CRL.M.A. 10375/2023 & CRL.M.A. 10374/2023 Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.
The applications stand disposed-of.

By way of the present petition filed under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioners seek quashing of chargesheet filed pursuant to case FIR No. 336/2013 dated 23.08.2013 registered under sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 at P.S.:
Bhajanpura.
2.

Mr. Priank Adhyaru, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits, that as recorded in judgment dated 01.03.2018 whereby the marriage of petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was dissolved by mutual consent upon second motion under section 13-B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act 1955, the parties had settled the matter inter-se;
and pursuant to the settlement, respondent No.2 has also received Rs.05 lacs out of the total amount of Rs.06 lacs due under the settlement.
It is submitted however, that now respondent No.2 is not co-operating in the quashing of the FIR.

3. It would appear that the settlement did contemplate quashing of the FIR since it is recorded in the aforesaid judgment that respondent No.2 would receive the balance Rs.01 lac at the time of quashing of the criminal case.
This is also reflected in the joint statement of the parties recorded by the learned Family Court.
4. Issue notice.

sentences.text:
Mr. Satinder Singh Bawa, learned APP appears for the State on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file status report.
6. Let status report be filed within 06 weeks; with copies to the opposing counsel.
7.
Upon the petitioners taking requisite steps, let notice be sent to respondent No.2 by all permissible modes, returnable for the next date.

8. Let the notice indicate that respondent No.2 is required to remain present in court on the next date.
9.
Mr. Adhyaru submits, that though the FIR dates back to 2013, even charges have not been framed in the trial court proceedings till date.
He submits that in view of what has been expressly recorded in the judgment of the learned Family Court, further proceedings before the learned trial court may be stayed.

10. In light of the above, on a prima-facie view of the matter, further proceedings before the learned trial court in case FIR No. 336/2013 dated 23.08.2013 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act registered at P.S.: Bhajanpura, shall remain stayed, till the next date of hearing before this court.

11. Re-notify on 19th September 2023.
